title: Seth--His Sacrifice Accepted--Rebellion in the Heavens--The
author: John Taylor
note: Published 1882. President Taylor's treatise on the Atonement. Extensive scripture citations. Companion to 'The Government of God'.

footnotes.text: "Revelation to Joseph, the Seer, given near Wight's Ferry, at a place called Spring Hill, Davis County, Missouri, May 19th, 1838, wherein Spring Hill is named by the Lord, Adam-ondi-Ahman, Because, said he, it is the place where Adam shall come to visit his people, or the Ancient of days shall sit, as spoken of by Daniel the Prophet."--Doc. and Cov. Sec. 116, p. 415.
